name: cio_preview_render_lq1318_20261109
comment: LQ-20261107-1318: a Home-CIO preview must be a RENDER of the same CIOOvernightBrief@v1 document Home
shows, never prose composed from the data. scripts/cio_preview_render.py refuses anything that is not
that document (free text, {}, wrong schema, a document with no run_id/generated_at/synopsis) with exit 2,
and --check runs scripts/lib/cio_brief_consistency.check_brief, exiting 1 on FAIL. The page repeats only
the document's words: the run id and ET clocks are on it, a HOLD row with an event states the event
(never a bare 'hold'), a mixed-run brief carries the run notice, and every string is HTML-escaped.
Exit 0 from main() is the gate's verdict, the page is the artifact. Synthetic fixtures; no network, no DB.
